settings.closingAnimation.title: Closing animation
settings.closingAnimation.description: Choose the animation that plays when a person leaves a waiting room, once for desktop and once for mobile. The small pictures are simplified stills, not the real animation.
settings.closingAnimation.inherit.descri: Follows whatever the platform has chosen.
settings.closingAnimation.design.CURTAIN: A red curtain closes over the right-hand area and opens again onto the message field.
settings.closingAnimation.design.SLIDE_R: The red area swipes to the right as one piece, a second red layer follows, and the chat is uncovered.
settings.closingAnimation.loadError: The settings could not be loaded. Please try again.
